blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —House prosecutors challenged Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s defense panel on Wednesday to show the business transactions behind Cale88 Foods Corp.’s China-linked receipts, saying registration papers could not explain the money flows being questioned in her impeachment trial. Former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, a spokesman and adviser for the prosecution panel, demanded evidence connecting the incoming funds to actual trade. “They should show by presenting evidence that Cale88 really had legitimate business and trade transactions,” Barbers said at an online press conference.
